reviewer_note: The codebase ALREADY has lib/widgets/offline_banner.dart (five states incl. a Retry action on send failure) mounted on the checklist screen (the only 'report list' surface) and ErrorView with a 'Try again' retry. Correct answer is therefore reuse-first: do not build a second banner; the real gap is that the offline state of the banner offers only 'Queue' and no manual retry/'Try again now' when signal comes back, so guidance that pushes a new component would be wrong for this codebase.
